description: This PHP class defines the UserEntity which implements OAuth2 UserEntityInterface, encapsulating user identification logic within the OAuth plugin of the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: UserEntity
classes.description: An implementation of OAuth2's UserEntityInterface for integrating user identification within the OAuth plugin.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the UserEntity with a user identifier string.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the user, satisfying the OAuth2 UserEntityInterface.

methods.name: createFromEntity
methods.description: Static factory method to create a UserEntity instance from a User object.
